Bounded review of d6f4e20/10cbae6: UI/evidence approved (6 render checks,57 hashes); independent state review found ONE narrow notification defect, so hold integration pending this same-card fix. No new campaign.

The rollback then restores job.status='not_sent' and returns without notifying. Reproduced with three ECONNREFUSED attempts, then ENOSPC on writing the retry intent: zero fourth upload; disk/originals unchanged; direct status unknown=0/not_sent=2 but the last pushed UI status remains unknown=2/not_sent=0. Data/send fencing works; the visible counts no longer match the known outcome. This is in your changed path.

Small fix: after restoring not_sent on that save failure, publish the corrected status while retaining the fault/sends_stopped and no additional transmission. Add one bounded regression pinning latest notification vs status and no request after failed persistence. Existing independent held ACK/Stop and refusal-before-read groups pass, so do not broaden or rerun GUI/DB/fullsuite. Preserve body/key, retries, existing baseline and exact old evidence. Independent reproduction artifacts are readable at /tmp/windows-win05-state-probes.mjs and .json (no production writes; generated candidate is in /tmp).

One nonblocking report correction may be included in the same leaf: docs/verification/web/windows-capture-link.md around155 still describes stalled as "not storing now"; current UI intentionally says "storage not confirmed now". Keep executed log/hash provenance separate from the later source correction.

Reply once with exact correction commit and focused evidence. Lead will review/integrate base+fix and release the actual candidate to QA for only pending-copy behavior; no restart of the earlier quit/capture campaign.
